note: Central affiliate/referral config. Fill 'code' with your REAL referral code for each exchange. When 'code' is empty the site falls back to the project's plain website URL (no referral parameter) — never invent a code: a fabricated one fails silently and earns nothing while looking like it works. 'template' is the signup URL with {code} substituted by your code. This is the ONLY file you edit to activate affiliate links.
